meta.format_note: Written to the project-map.md contract with two documented deviations: (1) nodes use an explicit `id` field instead of the dotted object key, (2) `edges` and `tests` are grouped by type with one shared `evidence` so each citation stays verifiable; every `source` value below is the `path[:line]` the claim came from. A `tests` index is included alongside the `tests`-typed edges so each suite's pass/fail status is recorded once.

summary_L0:
Arabic RTL booking-intake site for one paediatric clinic; a request is never a confirmation.
Static site (index.html + app.css + app.js) runs standalone in demo mode on localStorage and, when hosted by Google Apps Script, swaps its single api() bridge to google.script.run.
Backend is Code.gs in Apps Script: Sheets is the system of record (Requests/Audit/Closures), Calendar is the availability source, LockService serialises every write, staff approval is the only path to CONFIRMED.
Llm.gs is the sole LLM boundary (one provider: gemini, chain/budget/circuit/cache in Script Properties); the assistant is optional and booking works with it off.
Run the site with python3 scripts/preview.py on 0.0.0.0:8080; build the Apps Script bundle with python3 scripts/build-gas-package.py.
Test offline with node scripts/test-gas-simulated.js, test-llm-adapter.js, test-ui-smoke.js, test-demo-availability.js (jsdom needed for the last two).
Deploy the site with .github/workflows/pages.yml (main only); deploy the backend by pasting gas/ into Apps Script — never done, never verified in a real Google account.
No runtime npm dependencies; tooling is Node 20 / Python 3.11 stdlib only; every external service in docs/free-tiers.json is card_required:false.

risks: The whole backend (approval, locks, sheets, calendar) has never run inside a real Google account; only a vm-simulated harness covers it.
main is unprotected and the repo has 0 secrets / 0 variables, so the setup contract is declared but not configured.
Demo-mode availability duplicates the duration rule from Code.gs instead of sharing it; the two can drift.
Client-side demo PIN '2468' is rendered in index.html:219 and enforced in app.js; safe only because demo mode never claims a real confirmation.
